name: page-f893b7a7
page_data_script:
user = frappe.session.user

user_logged_in = False
user_data = None
billing_addresses = []
shipping_addresses = []

customer = None

if user != "Guest":
    # Step 1: Find Customer via portal_users child table
    portal_user_link = frappe.get_all(
        "Portal User",
        filters={"user": user},
        fields=["parent"]
    )

    if portal_user_link:
        customer = portal_user_link[0]["parent"]
        user_logged_in = True
        user_data = frappe.get_cached_doc("User", user)

        # Step 2: Get all addresses linked to this customer
        address_links = frappe.get_all(
            "Dynamic Link",
            filters={
                "parenttype": "Address",
                "link_doctype": "Customer",
                "link_name": customer
            },
            fields=["parent"]
        )

        address_names = [dl["parent"] for dl in address_links]

        if address_names:
            # Billing addresses
            billing_addresses = frappe.get_all(
                "Address",
                filters={
                    "name": ["in", address_names],
                    "address_type": "Billing",
                    "disabled": 0
                },
                fields=["*"]
            )

            # Shipping addresses
            shipping_addresses = frappe.get_all(
                "Address",
                filters={
                    "name": ["in", address_names],
                    "address_type": "Shipping",
                    "disabled": 0
                },
                fields=["*"]
            )

# -----------------------------
# Static Data
# -----------------------------
countries = [{"name": "United Kingdom"}]

mode_of_payments = [
    {"name": "Pay with Card"},
    {"name": "Pay on Account"}
]
# -----------------------------
# Assign to data object
# -----------------------------
data.user = user
data.user_logged_in = user_logged_in
data.user_data = user_data
data.shipping_addresses = shipping_addresses
data.billing_addresses = billing_addresses
data.countries = countries
data.mode_of_payments = mode_of_payments
data.page_data = {"csrf_token": frappe.session.csrf_token}
